findings.title: Sender domain authentication
findings.evidence: 1 sender domain(s) are missing a pass on SPF, DKIM, or DMARC.
findings.recommendedFix: Publish the missing DNS records before the next campaign.

findings.title: GDPR consent on forms
findings.evidence: 1 live form(s) have no GDPR consent field.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a consent checkbox and store the lawful basis.

findings.title: Tracking code on the public site
findings.evidence: The public page HTML does not include the HubSpot tracking script.
findings.recommendedFix: Add the portal tracking code to the site layout.

findings.title: Landing page call to action
findings.evidence: Published landing pages include a call to action.
findings.recommendedFix: Point the action at one form or one meeting link.

findings.title: Tracking on landing pages
findings.evidence: 1 published landing page(s) have no tracking script.
findings.recommendedFix: Add the portal tracking code to the landing page template.

findings.title: Published landing pages
findings.evidence: 1 landing page(s) are published.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep a draft only while it is still being edited.

findings.title: Duplicate companies
findings.evidence: 1 domain(s) are shared by more than one company.
findings.recommendedFix: Merge companies that share a domain.

findings.title: Duplicate contacts
findings.evidence: 1 email address(es) are shared by more than one contact.
findings.recommendedFix: Merge the duplicate contacts and turn on a create-time duplicate rule.

findings.title: Required properties filled
findings.evidence: 1 required property name(s) are below the fill ratio: email.
findings.recommendedFix: Make the thin properties required on the create forms and backfill the blanks.

findings.title: Workflow health
findings.evidence: 1 workflow(s) are in error. 1 active workflow(s) have no enrolment.
findings.recommendedFix: Open the errored workflows and fix the failing action.

findings.title: Form field mapping
findings.evidence: 1 form field(s) have no property mapping.
findings.recommendedFix: Map each field to a contact or company property.

findings.title: Live forms
findings.evidence: 2 form(s) are not archived.
findings.recommendedFix: Archive forms that no page still embeds.

findings.title: Spam protection
findings.evidence: 1 live form(s) have no spam protection.
findings.recommendedFix: Turn on CAPTCHA or another spam control.

findings.title: Sync errors
findings.evidence: 1 app(s) and 1 webhook(s) report sync errors.
findings.recommendedFix: Open the failing sync and replay or pause it.

findings.title: Email hooks by buyer stage
findings.evidence: 6 journey stage(s) have no matching published email: lead, marketingqualifiedlead, salesqualifiedlead, opportunity, customer, evangelist.
findings.recommendedFix: Add one email or workflow for each uncovered stage.

findings.title: Stale deals
findings.evidence: 1 sampled deal(s) have not been updated for 30 days or more.
findings.recommendedFix: Create a workflow that tasks the owner when a deal goes stale.

findings.title: Email subscription types
findings.evidence: No email subscription type was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Create subscription types before the next marketing send.

findings.title: Lifecycle funnel
findings.evidence: No lifecycle funnel report was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Build a funnel from subscriber to customer.

findings.title: Cookie banner
findings.evidence: The public page does not show a known cookie-banner marker.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a consent banner before non-essential HubSpot cookies load.

findings.title: Original source attribution
findings.evidence: Original source is missing on too many sampled contacts.
findings.recommendedFix: Stop blank imports from clearing original source.

findings.title: Brand markers on landing pages
findings.evidence: No brand markers are configured.
findings.recommendedFix: Add phrases, colour tokens, or asset names under params.markers.

findings.title: Landing page titles and descriptions
findings.evidence: 1 published landing page(s) are missing a title or meta description.
findings.recommendedFix: Fill the HTML title and meta description before the next campaign.

findings.title: Lifecycle and lead status
findings.evidence: 1 contact(s) use a conflicting lifecycle stage and lead status.
findings.recommendedFix: Clear the conflicting lead status when lifecycle stage changes.

findings.title: Nurture sequence
findings.evidence: No active nurture sequence was found.
findings.recommendedFix: Add one short nurture for new leads.

findings.title: Unengaged contacts
findings.evidence: No workflow handles unengaged contacts.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a sunset workflow after a set number of unopened emails.

findings.title: Follow-up email
findings.evidence: 1 embedded form(s) have no follow-up email.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a follow-up email or a workflow enrolment on submit.

findings.title: Webhook subscriptions
findings.evidence: 1 webhook subscription(s) are inactive.
findings.recommendedFix: Repair or remove the inactive subscription.

findings.title: Required fields per stage
findings.evidence: 1 pipeline(s) have a stage that does not require the configured fields.
findings.recommendedFix: Mark those properties required before a record can enter the stage.

findings.title: Automation on stage change
findings.evidence: 1 pipeline(s) have no stage-change automation.
findings.recommendedFix: Add a workflow or stage action for the first handoff stage.

findings.title: Deal stage probabilities
findings.evidence: 1 later deal stage(s) are below 40% probability.
findings.recommendedFix: Set a realistic probability on each open stage.

findings.title: Campaign links on live assets
findings.evidence: 2 published page or email asset(s) have no campaign.
findings.recommendedFix: Attach each live asset to a campaign.

findings.title: Dynamic lists
findings.evidence: No dynamic list was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Build dynamic lists for the stages you email.

findings.title: Lead score
findings.evidence: No lead-score property was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Turn on predictive lead scoring or name your score property in the YAML.

findings.title: Attribution reports
findings.evidence: No attribution report was returned.
findings.recommendedFix: Add an attribution report for paid and organic channels.

findings.title: Dashboards
findings.evidence: 1 dashboard(s) are present.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep one operating dashboard for the revenue team.

findings.title: UTM capture
findings.evidence: UTM properties exist but most sampled values are empty.
findings.recommendedFix: Pass UTM parameters into hidden form fields.

findings.title: Unused custom properties
findings.evidence: 1 custom property name(s) have no values: favourite_glass.
findings.recommendedFix: Archive unused properties or start collecting them on a form.

findings.title: Unused forms
findings.evidence: 1 live form(s) are not embedded.
findings.recommendedFix: Embed the form or archive it.

findings.title: Connected apps
findings.evidence: 1 app(s) are connected.
findings.recommendedFix: Remove apps you no longer use.

findings.title: Ticket pipeline
findings.evidence: 1 ticket pipeline(s) are defined.
findings.recommendedFix: Keep a closed stage and a required resolution field.
